report.text: Nobody can log in. The error log says: NameError: name 'pasword' is not defined.
report.hint: Read the variable name in the error very slowly.
report.explain: A misspelled variable name. One missing letter, one broken login.

report.text: The build fails with 'Unexpected token' on line 12, but line 12 looks perfect.
report.hint: The real problem is often on the line just above the one reported.
report.explain: A missing semicolon on line 11. The parser only notices when it reaches the next line.

report.text: The coupon code works when people type it, but fails for everyone who copy-pastes it.
report.hint: What sneaks in when you paste text that you can't see?
report.explain: Pasting brings an invisible trailing space, and the comparison never strips it.

report.text: After a one-line change, every page is blank and the console says 'Unexpected end of input'.
report.hint: The parser reached the end of the file while still waiting for something.
report.explain: A bracket was opened and never closed, so the parser hit the end of the file still waiting.

report.text: Our 'Top 10 players' leaderboard always shows exactly 9 people.
report.hint: Count where the loop starts and where it stops.
report.explain: A loop or slice stops one item early. Classic off-by-one.

report.text: The same test passes, fails, then passes again on a re-run. Nobody changed a single line.
report.hint: The code didn't change, so the result depends on something else: timing or order.
report.explain: The test depends on timing or run order, so it fails at random. A flaky test.

report.text: The app won't start. Line 42 of config.py now literally contains <<<<<<< HEAD.
report.hint: Those angle brackets were written by git, not by a person.
report.explain: A merge left its conflict markers in the file, and Python can't parse them.

report.text: Checkout works all day. But every night between 12:00 and 5:30 AM, orders are stamped with yesterday's date.
report.hint: Look at the exact hours. What's special about 5:30?
report.explain: The server stores dates in UTC. India is 5:30 ahead, so just after midnight IST it's still yesterday in UTC.

report.text: The profile page crashes, but only for users who never uploaded a photo.
report.hint: What does the code get when there's no photo at all?
report.explain: The code reads photo.url without checking that a photo exists. Nothing there, crash.

report.text: The server is fast after a restart, a little slower every day, and crashes about once a week.
report.hint: Something builds up over time and never goes away.
report.explain: Something keeps growing and is never freed, until the server runs out of memory.

report.text: One button pushes the CPU to 100% and the page never responds again.
report.hint: A frozen app with a busy CPU is doing something, forever.
report.explain: A loop whose exit condition never becomes true. The CPU spins forever.

report.text: The signup form rejects every email with a '+' in it, like ada+news@mail.com.
report.hint: Who decides which characters an email is allowed to contain?
report.explain: The validation regex only allows letters, digits and dots before the @. The Regex Monster strikes again.

report.text: Two people bought the last concert ticket in the same second, and both got a confirmation.
report.hint: Both requests arrived at the same moment. Who checked first?
report.explain: Both requests checked 'tickets left?' before either one updated the count.

report.text: The bug happens every time in production. The moment you add print statements to investigate, it disappears.
report.hint: The bug changes when you observe it. Think physics.
report.explain: Debugging changes the timing, so the bug hides whenever you look. A true Heisenbug.

report.text: The app froze. CPU at 0%, no errors, no crash. Two jobs are each waiting for the other to finish.
report.hint: Nothing is running, and everything is waiting.
report.explain: Each job holds a lock the other needs, so both wait forever. Deadlock.

report.text: QA says the export button is broken. You click it on your laptop and it works perfectly, every single time.
report.hint: It works for exactly one person. Which one?
report.explain: Something on your laptop (a file, a setting, a version) doesn't exist anywhere else. The legendary bug.

code.hint: Compare every variable name with where it was created.
code.explain: `mesage` is a typo for `message`, so Python raises NameError.

code.hint: JavaScript sometimes joins two lines into one.
code.explain: Without a semicolon, JavaScript reads lines 3 and 4 as `qty[discount, tax].forEach(...)`.

code.hint: What if someone pastes 'SAVE10 ' with a space at the end?
code.explain: The input is never `.strip()`-ed, so a pasted 'SAVE10 ' with a trailing space is rejected.

code.hint: Count the opening and closing braces.
code.explain: The `for` loop's `{` is never closed. A `}` is missing after line 4.

code.hint: Look closely at where the loop starts.
code.explain: `range(1, …)` skips the first score, so the average comes out too low.

code.hint: Is waiting exactly as long as the timeout always enough?
code.explain: Sleeping exactly 1 second races the 1-second TTL. Sometimes the key hasn't expired yet.

code.hint: Some of these lines weren't written by a person.
code.explain: Git's conflict markers were committed, and Python can't parse them. Keep one RETRIES line and delete the markers.

code.hint: The store is in India. Which clock is the code reading?
code.explain: `utcnow()` gives UTC, but the store's hours are in IST, so it 'opens' at 2:30 PM local time.

code.hint: What happens when there's no photo?
code.explain: `user.photo` is null, so `.url` throws. `user.photo?.url` would be safe.

code.hint: What happens to that list after a million requests?
code.explain: Every request is kept in a global list forever, so memory only ever grows.
`i++` moves away from 0, so `i > 0` stays true forever. It should be `i--`.

lines: return re.fullmatch(r"\d+.\d{2}", text) is not None
code.hint: In a regex, what does a bare dot match?
code.explain: The unescaped `.` matches any character, so '12a50' passes. It should be `\.`.

code.hint: Two buyers run this at the same moment. What do they both read?
code.explain: Both requests can read `available = True` before either one saves. The check and the update must happen atomically.

code.hint: Why would adding a slow print 'fix' it?
code.explain: Line 4 reads the result before the async fetch finishes. A slow print gives it just enough time, so debugging hides the bug.

lines: # transfer(x, y) and transfer(y, x) run at once
code.hint: Follow the order each call takes its locks.
code.explain: One call locks x then y, the other y then x, and each waits for the other forever. Always take locks in a fixed order.

code.hint: Does that file exist on anyone else's computer?
code.explain: A hard-coded path that only exists on one laptop. Everyone else gets FileNotFoundError.
